name: serve-sirius-unavailable-errors
title: Serve cannot contact Sirius
description: At least one Sirius unavailable error was recorded in the last minute.
investigation_steps: Check the Serve application logs for Sirius connection errors, is this an ongoing issue or a one time failure?
Check Sirius availability and the network path from Serve. Is Sirius reachable from the Serve environment? Is Sirius itself experiencing issues?
If the issue persists and affects production users, raise with the Sirius team where an incident will most likely need to be raised.

query: | filter @message like /NotFoundHttpException/ and @message like /No route found for/ and @message like /api\/passphrase/
